messages:
kevin: Heads-up — scheduling a midnight change window 2026-03-22 00:30–01:30 UTC. Cross-service cutover: API -> v2.1, Runtime -> v4.0.2, Router -> v1.9. Plan: canary + staged traffic shift. Any blockers?

jess: Ack. Canary window 10m with health checks sounds good. I need the console migration flag callout — console will need header compatibility toggled.

maria: I can own console flag toggles. We need to pin console to api v2.1 for the first 30m to avoid schema drift.

alex: Router team: router v1.9 has a different KV eviction threshold. If runtime is doing large KV writes we should reduce router fanout during canary. Tagging kv-evict as sensitive.

sam: Proposed traffic shift: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 5m intervals. Rollback if any of these triggers: sustained 5xx > 1% for 5m, median latency > 2x baseline for 3m, or consumer errors reported from console deploy.

deploy-bot: preflight started for batch: [api:v2.1, runtime:v4.0.2, router:v1.9, console:v2.1-pin]

deploy-bot: preflight results:
- infra quotas: OK
- image availability: OK
- schema compatibility: WARN (console header change detected)
- dependency pins: OK

kevin: Good catch on header warning. Maria — can you confirm console-compatible header shim will be enabled during canary? We want zero-downtime switch.

maria: I'll enable header_shim=true for first two intervals, then remove after full rollout. I'll prepare the toggle runbook.

jess: Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/apex-release-2026-03-22 (contains changelog + rollout schedule). Please add a one-liner in the notes about kv eviction change so support isn't surprised.

alex: Router runbook snippet (for quick rollback):
```
# quick rollback commands
deploy rollback --service router --to-version v1.8 --reason "post-canary 5xx"
# reduce fanout
routerctl set fanout 0.6
```

kevin: We'll do an initial pin of runtime and api for 40m to isolate behavioral regressions. Pin command (ops):
```
deploy pin --service runtime --version v4.0.2 --window 00:30-01:10UTC --reason "canary pin"
deploy pin --service api --version v2.1 --window 00:30-01:10UTC --reason "canary pin"
```

sam: On rollback thresholds — explicitly document: if any single endpoint crosses >2% 5xx for 2m, we abort and roll traffic back to previous variant immediately. If it's an internal infra alert (OOM, evictions) treat as immediate abort.

kevin: Roles: Maria -> console toggle and post-pin unpin. Alex -> router rollback/eviction controls. Jess -> release notes + monitor dashboards. Sam -> final go/no-go at 00:25 UTC. I will coordinate the traffic shifts.

oncall-bot: oncall alerting: if SLO breach occurs, page @oncall and escalate to @eng-sre. Pager duty runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/pager/slotting

jess: :thumbsup: I'll add the kv eviction note and attach a short synthetic test to the canary job (simple write-heavy seq).

maria: I'll post the toggle commands into the runbook and rehearse the unpin flow at 00:10 UTC quick-check.

kevin: Final question — any objections to staggered unpin at 00:50 for api, 00:55 for runtime, 01:00 for router? If none, I'll pin now and we proceed.

alex: No objections from router side. We'll watch evictions closely.

sam: No objections. Confirming rollback owners are assigned.

kevin: OK. Locking plan. Pinning shortly. Will post final checklist and a short summary before 00:25 UTC. :rocket:
